title: Air Quality (UCI) - Hourly gas multisensor + reference analyzer readings, Italian city 2004-2005
summary: Hourly averaged readings (9,357 rows, 15 columns) from a gas multisensor device and co-located certified reference analyzer, deployed at road level in a significantly polluted Italian city (city not named on the page). Covers 2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04. Contains true hourly NO2 concentration (µg/m³), CO (mg/m³), benzene, NMHC, NOx, plus sensor responses, temperature (°C), relative humidity (%) and absolute humidity. Missing values are coded as -200. The reference analyzer columns (NO2(GT), CO(GT), NOx(GT), etc.) have ~17% missing; the NMHC(GT) column is 90% missing. Sensor response columns (PT08.*) have ~4% missing. Designed for regression tasks on air quality estimation.

schema.notes: Variables are hourly averaged responses from 5 metal oxide sensors plus ground truth from a co-located certified reference analyzer. -200 sentinel used for missing values. Sensor drift and cross-sensitivities documented.

spatial.notes: The city is described only as 'an Italian city', 'significantly polluted area, at road level'. The exact city is not stated on the UCI page. The related De Vito et al. (2008) paper would identify it but doi.org is not accessible. Likely a northern Italian city.

documentation_excerpts: The device was located on the field in a significantly polluted area, at road level, within an Italian city. Data were recorded from March 2004 to February 2005 (one year) representing the longest freely available recordings of on field deployed air quality chemical sensor devices responses.

Ground Truth hourly averaged concentrations for CO, Non Metanic Hydrocarbons, Benzene, Total Nitrogen Oxides (NOx) and Nitrogen Dioxide (NO2) and were provided by a co-located reference certified analyzer.

Evidences of cross-sensitivities as well as both concept and sensor drifts are present as described in De Vito et al., Sens. And Act. B, Vol. 129,2,2008 (citation required) eventually affecting sensors concentration estimation capabilities.
Missing values are tagged with -200 value.
This dataset can be used exclusively for research purposes. Commercial purposes are fully excluded.
quality_notes: Missing values coded as -200, not as blanks — the variable table declares 'missing_values: no' for each column, but the dataset notes say 'Has Missing Values? Yes' and the sample confirms 1,592 -200 values in CO(GT) (~17%) and 8,443 in NMHC(GT) (~90%). This is a contradictory metadata declaration.
NMHC(GT) is 90.2% missing (-200) and largely unusable for modelling.

Licence contradiction: the UCI page displays a CC BY 4.0 badge (which permits commercial use), but the dataset notes within the same page say 'This dataset can be used exclusively for research purposes. Commercial purposes are fully excluded.' The risk assessor must determine which governs.
The city is not named — only 'an Italian city, significantly polluted area, at road level'. The use case targets northern Italy (Valdena), so geographic fit is unclear without the paper.
Sensor drift and cross-sensitivities are documented in De Vito et al. (2008) and may affect estimation quality.
Date format is MM/DD/YYYY (US-style), which needs careful parsing for non-US locales.
The sample date range (2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04) slightly exceeds the stated 'March 2004 to February 2005' — the file includes a few extra days at both ends.

sample_findings: Date: format MM/DD/YYYY, range 2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04, 391 distinct dates, no missing
Time: 24 distinct hourly values from 0:00:00 to 23:00:00, no missing
CO(GT): 83% non-missing, 1,592 sentinel -200 values (~17%), 91 negative values (some -200 counted as negative), range -200 to 11.9 mg/m³
NMHC(GT): only 9.8% non-missing, 8,443 sentinel -200 values (~90.2%) — largely unusable
C6H6(GT): 100% non-missing but 366 -200 values (appear in the range min=-200), range -200 to 63.7 µg/m³
NO2(GT): 82.5% non-missing, 1,642 sentinel -200 values (~17.5%), range 2-340 µg/m³, integer
NOx(GT): 82.5% non-missing, 1,639 sentinel -200 values, range 2-1479 ppb
T (Temperature): 96.1% non-missing, 366 sentinel -200, 13 negative values (freezing), range -1.9 to 44.6 °C
PT08 sensor columns: all ~96.1% non-missing, ~366 sentinel -200 each, no negatives, integer ranges ~300-2700
